The published MSF-04 A page and items/def-likelihood-ratio-as-rn-derivative.md were inspected. The definition gives the Radon-Nikodym derivative of the absolutely continuous component as an almost-everywhere class, identifies it as the full density exactly when P_theta is absolutely continuous with respect to P_0, and assumes AC. SME-51 proves P_theta << P_0 on the finite-pattern space before using the full derivative.

The filtration interface is the actual item-level supplier.
